page_title: CHE 1-1 LIV | Chelsea v Liverpool 13/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ian Maatsen.
90+3' A corner kick by Liverpool is thwarted by the well prepared Robert Sanchez (Chelsea).

90+3' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ben Chilwell trots off the pitch and is replaced by Chimuanya Ugochukwu (Chelsea).
89' The referee Anthony Taylor awards Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) a yellow card.
89' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) tries to find Darwin Nunez, but he puts too much power on the pass.
85' The foul by Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Anthony Taylor.
85' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is booked.
84' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
81' Raheem Sterling will be replaced by Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea).
81' Mauricio Pochettino decides to make a substitution. Carney Chukwuemeka will be replaced by Ian Maatsen (Chelsea).
81' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
79' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) comes onto the pitch so that Mohamed Salah can be given a rest.
77' Jurgen Klopp has decided to substitute Luis Diaz and he is replaced by Ben Doak (Liverpool).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Reece James leaves the pitch and Malo Gusto (Chelsea) comes on.
75' The flag goes up and the referee blows his whistle - another offside by Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea), who has already been caught several times today.
72' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Alisson.
71' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
68' Anthony Taylor has issued a yellow card to Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool).
68' The attendance for today's match is 40096.
66' Jurgen Klopp prepares a substitution. Diogo Jota is replaced by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
66' A substitution has been made. Cody Gakpo is replaced by Curtis Jones (Liverpool).
65' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

65' A lofted cross from Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee points to the corner flag and Chelsea will take a corner.
63' Reece James (Chelsea) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but the ball goes narrowly over the bar.
62' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Anthony Taylor stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Chelsea get a free kick.
59' Reece James (Chelsea) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Nicolas Jackson, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
59' The Chelsea players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
55' The corner is swung in but Chelsea can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
55' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Alisson makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
54' The resulting corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
54' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Liverpool as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

54' Play continues despite the shouts by some Liverpool players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
53' That looked a certain handball by Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
53' There's an opportunity for Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
52' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
50' Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea) attempts to release Nicolas Jackson with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.

50' What a chance that is! Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
48' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner but it's cleared.
48' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Liverpool get a corner.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+8' The end of the first half.
45+7' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) tries to find Ben Chilwell, but he puts too much power on the pass.
45+6' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
45+5' Dangerous play by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool). Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. Chelsea are awarded the free kick.
45+4' The game is interrupted now, Diogo Jota (Liverpool) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45+2' CHANCE! Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) connects with a cross but he cannot direct his shot on target.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' A cross from Reece James (Chelsea) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
44' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) latches onto a short pass from Reece James inside the box, but clips his shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
41' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Robert Sanchez easily deals with the threat.
41' The goal by Chelsea is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
40' The Chelsea players halt their celebrations as referee Anthony Taylor makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
39' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
37' 1 - 1 Gooal! Axel Disasi (Chelsea) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Ben Chilwell. He makes it 1:1.
37' Chelsea failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
36' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Corner kick. Chelsea will have an opportunity.
32' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
32' The expression of the referee Anthony Taylor is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is shown a yellow card.
31' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Liverpool due to an offside in the build-up play.
30' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Liverpool players aren’t happy.

29' Goal! Trent Alexander-Arnold slips a clever pass through to Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the right side of the goal. 0:2.
26' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
24' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the right post.
23' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) whips in the resulting free kick but one of the defenders heads the ball to safety.

22' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Mohamed Salah was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
18' 0 - 1 Mohamed Salah feeds the ball through to Luis Diaz (Liverpool), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:1!
17' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
16' Neat link-up play between Reece James (Chelsea) and Nicolas Jackson, but Alisson reads the game well and the move breaks down.
12' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
12' A pass lands at the feet of Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
10' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) takes a short corner kick.
10' Reece James (Chelsea) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Chelsea can continue in their attacking effort.
9' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
6' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
4' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea) for his blatant foul.
2' Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
2' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!

Chelsea will kick the game off.
Anthony Taylor will referee today's match.
